scientific_integrity: Proof is self-contained after classical Hilbert/Carleman inequalities and Mellin convolution identity; numerical script is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed-positive-threshold first-order epsilon counting, with edge expansions performed after this limit; no joint scaling or fixed-epsilon eigenvalue precision. Abstract-only 2026 motivating manuscript and possible general weighted Wiener-Hopf results are bibliographic risks.
title: Soft-cutoff spectral counting and a three-halves edge law for a power-tapered Hilbert matrix
